asr_text: Every morning, the employee looks for an empty desk. Someone else may have used it yesterday, and someone new may sit there tomorrow. They cannot leave papers in a drawer, and they sometimes worry about using a desk or keyboard after someone else. Before work begins, they have already spent time finding a place. They miss the same desk, drawer, and view. They helped them start without searching and gave them a quiet sense of belonging. Now the office can feel borrowed. They want their work and things to have a place, even when they cannot choose the seating policy.
